header.title: Spelling Lesson Maker
header.lessonsTooltip: Every lesson on this device. Switch between them, copy one, or start another; nothing you're working on is replaced.
header.previewTooltip: See the lesson exactly as a reader sees it
header.backToEditingTooltip: Return to the editor and keep working

documentPanel.suggestIdeasTooltip: Get AI lesson ideas tailored to this age range
documentPanel.editingPublishedTooltip: You're editing a lesson you published. Saving to the cloud overwrites it in the hub. This status is saved until you update it or fork into a new lesson.
documentPanel.editingDraftTooltip: You're editing a draft backed up to the cloud. Only you can see it; saving updates the backup, or you can publish it to the hub. This status is saved until you change it or fork into a new lesson.
documentPanel.forkTooltip: Start a new lesson from this one and carry on in it. The new lesson keeps this one's history, so it can be merged back later, and this one stays on your device.
documentPanel.syncTooltip: Bring in the changes made to {{name}} since you forked it. Edits to different blocks (or to different parts of the same block) merge automatically; anything genuinely clashing is put to you.
documentPanel.proposeTooltip: Offer your work back to {{name}}. Nothing there changes: your version is sent as a proposal, and its author (or someone they trust) decides whether to merge it in.
documentPanel.variationsTooltip: You're working on the main lesson, the one everyone sees. Click to try changes on a separate copy instead.
documentPanel.onVariationTooltip: You're working on a variation. The main lesson stays exactly as it is until you bring this in. Click to switch back or manage your variations.
documentPanel.updateProposalTooltip: Replace what "{{title}}" contains with your work as it stands now. Its title, note and any discussion stay where they are.

history.label: Version history
history.tooltip: Every version of this lesson is saved automatically as you work. Click to browse them and go back to any one.

emptyState.heading: No sections yet
emptyState.instruction: Tap the + button to create your first lesson section.

preview.note: This is the lesson as a reader sees it. Nothing here can be edited. Use Back to editing to make a change.

wordImportWarning.title: Import a Word document
wordImportWarning.body1: Importing a <0>.docx</0> file is <1>best-effort and lossy</1>. It works best with documents exported from this app; files written elsewhere may import poorly or not at all.
wordImportWarning.body2: For the import to work, the document must use <0>Heading 2</0> styles for its section headings. Images, colours, and exact formatting may be lost.
wordImportWarning.body3: If the document isn't structured as a lesson, it won't be opened. Either way the lesson you're working on is left alone: an import opens as a new lesson of its own.

documentImport.title: Import from text
documentImport.description: Paste a lesson from anywhere, or choose a text or Word file that wasn't made by this app. Each section needs its passage first, then its questions, one per line, with any answer after the question.
documentImport.sectionCounts: {{paragraphs}} paragraphs · {{words}} spelling words · {{questions}} questions ({{answered}} with answers)
documentImport.typesNote: Question types are worked out from the answers and the wording, so check them after importing.
documentImport.nothingFound: No lesson was found in this text yet. It needs at least one passage followed by its questions, one question per line.

messages.addSectionBeforeExporting: Add at least one section before exporting.
messages.addSectionBeforeSaving: Add at least one section before saving.
messages.savedToGoogleDrive: Saved to Google Drive as a Google Doc.
messages.addSectionBeforePreviewing: Add at least one section before previewing.
messages.pleaseSignIn: Please sign in to save your lesson to the cloud.
messages.needsMergeBeforeSave: Someone else has changed this lesson since you last synced. Merge their changes, then save again. Nothing has been overwritten.
messages.historyNotSaved: the version history couldn't be saved
messages.savedWithHistoryWarning: Lesson saved, but {{warning}}. Your history is safe on this device and will upload next time you save.
messages.draftSaved: Draft saved to the cloud. Only you can see it.
messages.libraryUnavailable: This browser wouldn't let us open the lessons stored on this device; another tab may be using an older version of the app. You can keep working, but nothing will be saved here until you reload.
messages.forkedNoUpstream: Forked into a new lesson. Saving to the cloud will create a separate copy. The lesson you forked is still on this device.
messages.noSharedHistoryToMerge: The original lesson has no shared history to merge; it may have been published before version history, or deleted.
messages.alreadyUpToDate: Already up to date with the original.
messages.proposalOpened: Your changes have been proposed to {{name}}. Its author has been notified, and can review and merge them.
messages.proposalGone: That proposal is no longer available. It may have been withdrawn or already resolved.
messages.proposalResolved: That proposal has already been merged or closed.
messages.proposalMerged: Merged "{{title}}" into this lesson. Whoever proposed it has been notified.
messages.mergedFromHubPublish: Merged the changes from the hub. Save to the cloud again to publish the merged lesson.
messages.wordImportFailed: This Word document couldn't be imported. Please check it and try again.
messages.jsonImportFailed: This JSON file couldn't be imported. Please check it and try again.
messages.importedJson: Imported from JSON. Review the lesson, then save it to the cloud when you're ready.
messages.importedWord: Imported from Word. Word import is best-effort, so review the lesson, as some formatting or content may have been lost.
messages.importedText: Imported from text. Check the question types and answers, which were worked out from the wording, then save it to the cloud when you're ready.
messages.forkedWithHistory: Forked into a new lesson; its full history came with it. Edit freely, then save it as your own copy.
messages.forkedWithoutHistory: Forked into a new lesson. Edit freely, then save it to the cloud as your own copy.
messages.loadedPublished: Loaded your published lesson. Edit and save to the cloud to update it.
messages.loadedDraft: Loaded your draft. Edit and save to the cloud, or publish it to the hub.
messages.loadedLocalCopyDiffers: Opened your copy of this lesson from this device. It isn't identical to the one in the cloud. Saving to the cloud settles that, and asks you about anything that clashes.
messages.couldNotOpenLesson: Could not open that lesson for {{action}}.
messages.variationBroughtIn: "{{name}}" is now part of the main lesson.
messages.variationAlreadyIn: "{{name}}" is already part of the main lesson.
messages.couldNotUndo: That change could not be undone: {{error}}
messages.nothingToUndo: That change isn't in the lesson any more, so there's nothing to undo.
messages.undone: That change has been undone. Everything since it is still here.
messages.tryingInVariation: Started a variation called "{{name}}" to try these changes in.
messages.proposalInVariation: These changes are now in your "{{name}}" variation. The main lesson is untouched, and the proposal is still waiting for your decision.
messages.proposalAlreadyIn: The lesson already contains these changes.
messages.tryingInExistingVariation: Switched to your "{{name}}" variation to try these changes in.
messages.nothingToMergeInto: The main lesson has no versions yet, so there is nothing to bring these changes into.
